tldr: Biggest risk to the book: silver BROKE below $58 (~$57.64, -3.5% Fri) as the oil spike flipped Fed pricing from a 2026 cut toward a possible HIKE — levered silver is the most rate-sensitive holding; trim/hedge into the 28-29 Jul FOMC, don't add.

Master driver is the escalating US-Iran war (13th night of CENTCOM strikes); oil topped $100 then reversed ~4% Friday on Pakistan/China-brokered de-escalation talks — a genuine ceasefire is the fastest catalyst to relieve silver, S-REITs and crypto at once.
Gold is holding far better (~$4,048 off a $4,130 high) than silver — favor gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage while the war/inflation tug-of-war runs.
HK tech firm — Hang Seng reclaimed 25,000, Tencent +3.5% on near-daily buybacks — but China Q2 GDP missed at 4.3%; the late-July Politburo is the binary. Favor Tencent over Xiaomi.

Smart money: Berkshire deployed ~$10B into Alphabet and resumed buybacks; Burry (now personal, post-Scion) is short NVDA/MU/AMD — the AI-capex-peak trade. Q2 13Fs due 14 Aug.

regime.label: Oil shock fades but rates & a firm dollar crush metals into a hawkish-hold Fed
regime.oneLiner: Equities hold near highs on calm credit and low VIX, but an oil-led shift toward pricing a 2026 Fed HIKE lifted yields to a year-high ~4.71% and a firm dollar, crushing metals (silver <$58) — the US-Iran war escalation-vs-de-escalation is the swing into the 29 Jul FOMC.

topNews.headline: Silver breaks below $58 (~$57.64, -3.5%) as oil-driven inflation revives rate-hike bets
topNews.actionable: The levered silver core is the book's biggest short-term vulnerability — trim leverage or hedge the silver-vs-gold spread into the FOMC; an Iran de-escalation is the fastest relief.

topNews.headline: US-Iran war escalates; oil topped $100 then reversed ~4% Friday on de-escalation talk
topNews.actionable: The single event driving every cross-current: bullish gold/oil/Seatrium, but the inflation impulse keeps the Fed/MAS hawkish — a headwind for silver, S-REITs and HK tech. Trade the de-escalation odds.

topNews.headline: Fed seen on hold 28-29 Jul, but markets now price a possible 2026 rate HIKE on oil
topNews.actionable: The 'one cut → possible hike' shift is the core near-term threat to levered silver and SGX REITs; the big USD cash pile (~3.5-3.75%) is an asset — stay patient into the print.
